exit_criteria: Every populated gate field renders in the current projection, with a completeness property test that catches the next field someone adds and forgets.

issues.title: Render directives in the current projection
issues.desired_outcome: A populated directives block reaches the agent through the engine projection, and the class of unrendered-field defects is closed by a completeness property rather than one more golden.
issues.useful_now: Everything in this epic reads through the projection, and directives is inert until it renders. C cannot relocate instruction into a channel that does not show it.
issues.appetite: One gate, with the completeness property as the durable part
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A populated directives block appears in the current output; the completeness property test enumerates the fields a gate may carry and fails when a populated one is missing. Falsified if the property passes with a field deliberately unrendered.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the rendering shape and where the property test lives. If the inventory shows a field is vestigial, deleting it is the accepted smaller fix - say so on the evidence.

issues.title: Episode records read as prescriptions rather than observations
issues.desired_outcome: The episode store holds records of what happened, with the roughly 24 of 32 canon workarounds that read as instructions either rewritten as observations or routed to doctrine by a human decision.
issues.useful_now: This is the playbook retirement undoing itself at the authoring end, inside the store that replaced it. Left alone it rebuilds the thing #447 just removed.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A check that can fail distinguishes an observation from an instruction, and the existing records pass it or are dispositioned. Falsified if the check passes on a record that plainly instructs.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the mechanism and the wording standard. Promoting anything into docs/agents doctrine is surfaced to the Admiral and is a human call, never taken locally.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not create a successor playbook under any name.
Do not promote an observation into docs/agents without the human decision.

issues.title: The episode-store negative control fails between git add and commit
issues.desired_outcome: The negative control stops failing on every run that legitimately captures an episode.
issues.useful_now: A control that fires on correct behaviour trains agents to ignore it, which is worse than not having it.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The control passes across the add-to-commit window while still failing when the store genuinely regresses. Falsified if it cannot be made to fail at all.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the fix; keep the control able to register its own failure.

issues.title: CONSTELLATION_FEEDBACK Lesson field takes an episode id but keeps its old name
issues.desired_outcome: The field is renamed to match what it now carries, in one change together with its collector.
issues.useful_now: A field whose name contradicts its contents is a standing misread for every future agent.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The field and scripts/collect_feedback.py agree, in a single change, with the suite green. Falsified by any remaining reader of the old name.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the new name. Enumerate every reader of the old one by command before calling it done.

issues.title: Reviewer r6-fowler ships a placeholder no engine verb can fill
issues.desired_outcome: The reviewer step is fillable through an engine verb, and filling it stops rewriting every line ending in the state file.
issues.useful_now: A gate no verb can satisfy is a gate that gets waived, and a CRLF rewrite destroys the blame on whatever it touches.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The step is satisfied through an ordinary engine verb, and the state file is byte-stable apart from the intended change. Falsified if filling it still rewrites unrelated lines.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose whether the fix is to the template, the verb, or the writer.

issues.title: Confirm the worktree-precondition enumeration check catches a real second template
issues.desired_outcome: The enumeration check is observed refusing a genuinely new worktree-entering template, rather than only passing on the set it already knows.
issues.useful_now: This is the D falsification debt. An enumeration that has never been observed refusing is a check that cannot fail.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A genuinely new worktree-entering template is introduced and the check refuses. Falsified if the check passes on it - which would be the finding.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how to introduce the template; revert it in the same change that induces it.

wave_review_comment:
## Wave review - boundary w1-to-w2

Waves 0 and 1 are merged and closed. Main is green at `ca0e36a`: **1721 passed, 4 skipped, 643
subtests, exit 0**, with the real exit code captured.

### What the boundary found

| Signal | Disposition |
|---|---|
| The installed skill corpus was stale against the repo - 12 skills, 6 in `SKILL.md`, including `commander-delegated` and `workbench` | Resolved here by syncing the install; zero non-launcher differences remain |
| The installed Admiral spine called `apply_lessons_delta.py` and `verify_agent_feedback.py`, both deleted by #447 | Avoided by instantiating from the repo template; the sync fixed the root |
| #447 was open while its core obligation was already met | Closed here with a per-done-condition accounting |
| The predecessor green figures (1723/2 and 1764) do not match this measurement (1721/4) | Recorded, not reconciled; the measured baseline at a named revision governs |
| The playbook retirement is leaking back at the authoring end (#460) | Pulled into the current wave rather than left for E |
| The governor hook is unwired, so the governor fires nowhere on a shipped config | Stays off-chain as #458; it gates done-condition 1, not this wave |

### Honest note on #447

Its fourth done-condition - *nothing reads episodes as prescriptions* - is **partially met**. The
read path is retired and no consumer conditions behaviour on the store, but #460 found the
obligation leaking back at the authoring end. That was stated as partial rather than claimed as
done, and the remainder is tracked and scheduled rather than dropped. This matters because #447
exists precisely to catch a close that claims an unmet obligation.

## Current planning truth - epic #418

**Wave 2 (current): B extended.** Make the engine projection show the agent the whole gate, and
stop the playbook retirement from growing back inside the episode store.

| Issue | What it settles |
|---|---|
| #433 | `directives` renders, and a completeness property closes the class rather than the instance |
| #460 | Episode records read as observations, not instructions |
| #461 | The episode-store negative control stops failing on correct behaviour |
| #464 | The `Lesson:` field is renamed to match what it now carries |
| #465 | The reviewer placeholder becomes fillable without rewriting every line ending |
| #436 | The worktree enumeration check is observed actually refusing |

Exit criteria are on the wave, not the issues: every populated gate field renders under a
completeness property; episode records pass an authoring-end check that can fail; each issue
declares its subsumption candidate set before starting and reports how many it closed; the suite
is green against the 1721-passed baseline at `ca0e36a`.

**Forecast, nonbinding:** A2 trip semantics (still needs cutting, deliberately deferred so it is
cut against what B extended leaves behind), then F, then C, then E. Off-chain and runnable at any
point: #458 ship the gauge writer, #452 multi-spine attribution.

**Two of five done-conditions remain unmet:** the projection does not render every populated gate
block, and no agent has driven a real role spine through the MCP door. Done-condition 4 was
retired and replaced by the standing obligation that each workstream retires the findings it
subsumes, against a candidate set declared before it starts.
